i1.title: Karl Lagerfeld Fleur d'Iris Eau de Parfum 100ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Soft, powdery iris wrapped in warm vanilla.

Karl Lagerfeld Fleur d'Iris Eau de Parfum 100ml is an amber floral fragrance for women from the Les Parfums Matières collection, launched in 2025. Mandarin and orange blossom open it bright and luminous, a heart of iris and orchid brings a soft, powdery elegance, and it settles into a warm, comforting base of heliotrope, vanilla and musk.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Mandarin, Orange Blossom
  • Heart: Iris, Orchid
  • Base: Heliotrope, Vanilla, Musk

Key details

  • Brand: Karl Lagerfeld
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Floral · Amber · Powdery
  • Wear: Women

Why you'll love it

  • A bright mandarin and orange blossom opening
  • A soft, powdery iris and orchid heart
  • A warm heliotrope, vanilla and musk base
  • Generous 100ml Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does Fleur d'Iris smell like?

Mandarin and orange blossom first, then iris and orchid, finishing with heliotrope, vanilla and musk.

Is it for women?

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.

i2.title: Karl Lagerfeld Fleur de Pivoine Eau de Parfum 100ml
i2.descriptionHtml:
Fresh-cut peony with a bright, green sparkle.

Karl Lagerfeld Fleur de Pivoine Eau de Parfum 100ml is a fresh floral fragrance for women from the Les Parfums Matières collection, launched in 2023 and created by perfumer Emilie Bevierre-Coppermann. Mandarin and green notes open it crisp and fresh, a heart of peony, lily of the valley and jasmine blooms soft and feminine, and it settles into a clean base of white cedar, musk and amber.

i3.title: Karl Lagerfeld for Him Eau de Toilette 100ml
i3.descriptionHtml:
Fresh, modern fougère with a crisp green twist.

Karl Lagerfeld for Him Eau de Toilette 100ml (also sold as Karl Lagerfeld Pour Homme) is an aromatic fougère for men, launched in 2014 and created by perfumer Jean-Christophe Hérault. Mandarin and lavender open it fresh and aromatic, a heart of violet and green apple adds a crisp, modern lift, and it dries down to a smooth base of sandalwood and amber.

i5.title: Karl Lagerfeld Ikonik Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 100ml
i5.descriptionHtml:
Juicy raspberry, radiant jasmine and creamy sandalwood.

Karl Lagerfeld Ikonik Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 100ml is a floral amber woody fragrance for women, launched in 2024 and created by perfumer Marie Salamagne. Raspberry, mandarin and rose open it juicy and vibrant, a heart of jasmine sambac, tuberose and a gourmand hazelnut macaron accord brings radiant, addictive warmth, and it settles into a creamy base of sandalwood, musk and vetiver.
